pending_reason: A has not supplied its exact quality freeze; no B-proposed fixture value is approved as a field parameter
shadow_requirement: entire dependency closure for every real influence; target link excluded from observations AND initialization/history/cache/carried prior. Labels alone are insufficient: source review and target-only intervention/prefix controls also required
native_A_adapter_status: PENDING; if A freezes another rule, independently implement that declared formula/FSM rather than force it into this proposal
weight_semantics: information multiplier: sqrt(w) times existing signed pseudo-Huber range residual; baseline multiplier 1. Native alternatives require an explicit tested adapter
unknown: null score with explicit reason; never silently healthy or zero-filled; conservative action must be declared
objective_readback: B scalar residual formulas, per-factor effective weight and independently rebuilt total cost; do not import A quality decisions
counterfactual_control: change only target-link observations; after actual marginalization, every target-excluded shadow pose/prior/cache/initial state must remain invariant. Main graph is allowed to change
prefix_control: receive-ordered prefixes; compare all non-timing decisions, identities, scores, weights and published values; no future-closed-history rewrite
event_language: trigger events, not false positive/false negative rates
reference_policy: manual endpoints and frozen stop windows exist only in offline evaluation, never quality policy/config/threshold selection
counterfactual_canonicalization: Compare effective non-target scalar values + stable original identities, and numerical shadow states/guesses/priors/cache content. Ignore global input-file/message-envelope SHA differences caused solely by a private target intervention, and ignore timing. Preserve separate actual altered-input SHA; never label altered events as unchanged raw data.
missing_constraint: No admissible five-sample median: constraint_exists=false, raw range and actual old/new factor weights null, explicit unknown reason and no graph factor. Do not invent a zero measurement/weight.
support_policy: Full original arrived bin support, not selected best five. Scalar identity includes message SHA/physical record index plus field component; a message with multiple anchors cannot hide target input as a generic frame.
